title: Fix iwd PMK generation failed error
summary: This error occurs when the Wi-Fi password (passphrase) is too short or too long. iwd requires PSK pass-phrases to be between 8 and 63 ASCII characters.
error_patterns: PMK generation failed. Ensure Crypto Engine is properly configured

steps.explain: Check that your Wi-Fi password is between 8 and 63 characters long. If it is shorter or longer, you cannot connect using standard WPA2-PSK. Contact your network administrator to change the password or use a different authentication method.
